title.en: Query-image TV blindness floor, multi-query separation, and three-regime error contrast

statement.en: Over Mathlib ℝ (standard axioms only), ObservationalFidelity proves the query TV blindness floor, empty-source infeasibility, zero-TV coexistence with FiberViabilitySplit, three-way query separation, Dobrushin-MetricLaxSim kernel tubes, [0,1] risk transfer, and sharp/feedback controls.

laws.en: Finite pushforward obeys total-variation data processing (tvDist_pushforward_le); for any chi : U -> V, query q : V -> O, and mu : FinDist V, every local distribution nu obeys massOutside (q o chi) (pushforward q mu) <= tvDist (pushforward (q o chi) nu) (pushforward q mu), with equality constructively attained when Nonempty U while IsEmpty U renders FinDist U empty (optimal_query_tv_floor, empty_source_infeasible).

Post-composing observations with a coarsening map or factoring maps through a finer macro partition weakly lowers massOutside (coarsening_tv_mono, macro_refinement_tv_mono), while zero observable query TV on dirac distributions coexists with FiberViabilitySplit (in-phase viable, anti-phase non-viable), refuting any sound and complete macro predicate on Becoming.OplaxHistory.C2CoupledAlignmentWitness.

On diagonal Bool x Bool supports, individual per-query zero TV does not imply simultaneous marginal feasibility (per_query_not_implies_joint_marginal, sum gap >= 3/5), and simultaneous zero-TV marginals over uniform Bool x Bool fail joint TV realizability (joint_marginal_not_implies_joint_dist, tvDist >= 1/2).

Open-loop Markov kernels accumulate per-step TV error linearly (sequential_kernel_tv_bound) and subadditively across independent tensor sites (independent_tensor_tv_bound), while three_regime_error_contrast and three_regime_kernel_contrast join linear drift, contractive closed-loop tubes, and feedback/C2/concurrent breakdown.

rowDefect bounds massOutside f (optimal_floor_le_rowDefect); Dobrushin alpha in [0,1) contracts pushKernel TV (tvDist_pushKernel_dobrushin/_step) and with uniform rowDefect <= eps instantiates MetricLaxSim (kernelMetricLaxSim), giving iterated TV bounds and Viability.Kernel transfer from a macro certificate, initial invQ within d0 >= 0, and guardS closure on the max(d0, eps/(1-alpha)) tube.

For [0, 1]-bounded readout b with |h u - b (f u)| <= gamma, expectation discrepancy is <= gamma + tvDist (viability_risk_transfer_bound), while a {0, 1} fiber split forces 1/2 <= gamma (fiber_split_readout_floor); sharp_oplax_dobrushin_attainment hits d_n = eps*(1-alpha^n)/(1-alpha) for all n, and feedback_destroys_openloop_contraction turns alpha=0 rows into an identity.

Over FiniteProbKrylov, zero rowDefect characterizes pushforward commutation (rowDefect_eq_zero_iff_pushforward, modeRowDefect_eq_zero_iff_pushforward) and exists-L characterization of FiberLumpable (fiberLumpable_iff_exists_zero_rowDefect), while mismatched fixed L still yields rowDefect = 1 on FiberLumpable Bool fibers (fixed_macro_nonzero_rowDefect_witness).

hypotheses.en: Lean v4.30.0-rc2 + Mathlib standard axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) through the Mathlib periphery workspace; requires finite Fintype state/query spaces, Nonempty U for optimal TV attainment, time-homogeneous Markov steps, and [0, 1]-bounded macro readout b for risk transfer.

kernel_contraction_tube_via_metricLaxSim additionally assumes alpha in [0, 1), uniform Dobrushin bound <= alpha, uniform rowDefect <= eps (eps >= 0), a macro Viability.Certificate (guardQ, invQ), initial invQ lam0 with tvDist (pushforward f p0) lam0 <= d0 (d0 >= 0), and guard closure (guardQ lam and tvDist (pushforward f p) lam <= max d0 (eps / (1 - alpha)) -> guardS p).

does_not_show.en: Finite probability distribution TV bounds and discrete counterexamples never verify that empirical neural policy rollouts or real sensor pipelines are time-homogeneous, independent across sites, or contractive (Rule 2).
Does not prove finite-sample empirical convergence rates, continuous measurable-space Radon-Nikodym bounds, or continuous-time SDEs.

detail.en: empty_source_infeasible (IsEmpty U), zero_tv_does_not_prevent_fiber_viability_split (zero TV on C2CoupledAlignmentWitness where in-phase has Viability.Kernel and anti-phase lacks one, refuting any sound and complete macro predicate), per_query_not_implies_joint_marginal (3/5 gap), joint_marginal_not_implies_joint_dist (1/2 gap), sharp_oplax_dobrushin_attainment (tight d_n equality on Bool), fiber_split_readout_floor (1/2 gap on {0,1} split), feedback_destroys_openloop_contraction (alpha=0 rows switching to alpha=1 identity), three_regime_error_contrast part 3 (ConcurrentSerialWitness depletion), and fixed_macro_nonzero_rowDefect_witness (FiberLumpable singleton fibers with mismatched fixed L giving rowDefect = 1).
